title: Not Built For This #5: The Little Levee That Could

sentences.en: This is episode 5 of Not Built for This, The Little Levy That Could.

sentences.zh: 当我们举办第一次活动时，人们真的以为是中央情报局（CIA）。

sentences.en: In order to recruit people to the CIA, Jose would go around town giving a little spiel about
sentences.zh: 为了招募人员加入CIA，何塞会四处奔走，向任何愿意倾听的人发表简短演说，

sentences.en: the need for a new levee to anyone who would listen.
sentences.zh: 讲述修建新堤坝的必要性。

sentences.en: I would see him at all of our nonprofit meetings, the Lions Club, the Women's Club, that type of thing.
sentences.zh: 我会在我们所有的非营利组织会议上见到他，比如狮子会、妇女俱乐部之类的场合。

sentences.en: I would see him all the time coming, giving his speech.
sentences.zh: 我总是看到他来发表他的演讲。

sentences.en: And, you know, the more people that get involved, the better off we are.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，参与的人越多，对我们就越有利。
这位是莉安·格里斯比·普恩特。

sentences.en: Leanne didn't know that much about the levee or the Army Corps of Engineers and its benefit-cost ratio.
sentences.zh: 莉安当时对堤坝、陆军工程兵团及其效益成本比了解并不多。

sentences.en: She also didn't really know that much about Jose, but she understood his sense of urgency.
sentences.zh: 她对何塞也不是很了解，但她理解他那种紧迫感。
我是在农业环境中长大的。

sentences.en: We know what it's like to have to protect the land and the power of water.
sentences.zh: 我们知道保护土地和应对水力意味着什么。

sentences.en: And that's what a lot of people don't understand.
sentences.zh: 而这正是许多人不理解的地方。

sentences.en: And she thought she might have something to offer.
sentences.zh: 她觉得也许自己能帮上忙。

sentences.en: I mean, I can take notes.
You know, I can answer a phone.
You know, those types of things.
sentences.zh: 你知道，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: I said, I want to help.
And next thing I knew, I was coming to big meetings.
sentences.zh: 接下来我就发现自己开始参加大型会议了。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, what did I get into?
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，噢，我这是卷进了什么事？

sentences.en: Pretty soon, Leanne was a fixture at these meetings.
sentences.zh: 很快，莉安就成了这些会议上的常客。

sentences.en: And she and Jose became partners in crime.
sentences.zh: 她和何塞成了志同道合的伙伴。

sentences.en: Leanne was the talker, the mouthpiece for the organization, while Jose was quietly getting
sentences.zh: 莉安是组织里的发言人，是代言人，而何塞则在幕后默默地

sentences.en: They started spending so much time together working on the levee project that they became
sentences.zh: 他们在一起为堤坝项目投入了大量时间，以至于变得

sentences.en: A few years after founding the CIA, they got married.
sentences.zh: 在成立CIA几年后，他们结婚了。

sentences.en: So your whole relationship is based on the levee.
sentences.zh: 所以你们整个关系都是建立在堤坝之上的。
还有那条正在侵蚀的堤坝。

sentences.en: But Hamilton City's new power couple was facing an uphill battle.
sentences.zh: 但汉密尔顿市这对新晋的“权力夫妻”正面临一场艰苦的战斗。

sentences.en: Because even if they could somehow get the Army Corps of Engineers to agree that it was
sentences.zh: 因为即使他们能设法让陆军工程兵团同意修建新堤坝是

sentences.en: worth it to build them a new levee, it turns out Hamilton City would actually need to pay
sentences.zh: 值得的，汉密尔顿市实际上还需要支付

sentences.en: With big infrastructure projects like this, the local people have to make a significant
sentences.zh: 对于这类大型基础设施项目，当地居民必须为成本做出重大

sentences.en: Which, for a big city, can be fine.
sentences.zh: 这对大城市来说可能没问题。

sentences.en: But for a tiny, unincorporated community like Hamilton City, was pretty much impossible.
sentences.zh: 但对于像汉密尔顿市这样微小的非建制社区来说，这几乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: Well, there was no way that the locals could meet the 25 percent.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当地人根本无法凑齐那25%的费用。

sentences.en: It wasn't exactly clear how much that would be, but it was certainly in the millions and
sentences.zh: 虽然具体金额并不完全清楚，但肯定在数百万，

sentences.en: potentially in the tens of millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能高达数千万美元。

sentences.en: They weren't going to raise that money all at once, but they needed to start somewhere.
sentences.zh: 他们不可能一次性筹集到这笔钱，但总得从某处开始。

sentences.en: And Leanne and Jose came up with an idea.
sentences.zh: 于是莉安和何塞想出了一个主意。

sentences.en: They would throw a levee festival in downtown Hamilton City and ask all the best cooks in town
sentences.zh: 他们要在汉密尔顿市中心举办一场堤坝节，并邀请镇上所有最棒的厨师

sentences.en: And to our surprise, everybody said yes.
sentences.zh: 令我们惊讶的是，大家都答应了。

sentences.en: So if your family was good at making tamales, then that family did tamales.
sentences.zh: 如果你的家人擅长做玉米粽，那这家人就负责做玉米粽。

sentences.en: If your family was good at making carnitas, then that's who made the carnitas, carne asada,
sentences.zh: 如果你的家人擅长做炖猪肉，那这就是他们做的炖猪肉、烤肉、

sentences.en: Citizens in Action started hosting one or two levee festivals a year.
sentences.zh: “公民行动组织”开始每年举办一两次堤坝节。

sentences.en: They were fundraisers, but also acts of political theater.
sentences.zh: 它们既是筹款活动，也是一种政治表演。

sentences.en: To show the powers that be just how badly this little community wanted a new levee.
sentences.zh: 为了向当权者展示这个小社区有多么渴望修建新堤坝。

sentences.en: They would invite local politicians and nonprofits and people from the Army Corps.
sentences.zh: 他们会邀请当地政客、非营利组织和陆军工程兵团的人员参加。

sentences.en: And they knew that they wouldn't have any problem getting the people of Hamilton City to show up.
sentences.zh: 他们知道，让汉密尔顿市的居民出席活动完全没问题。

sentences.en: We're lucky Jose is probably related to half the town.
sentences.zh: 我们很幸运，何塞大概和半个镇的人都有亲戚关系。

sentences.en: Not so lucky for our children and our grandchildren.
sentences.zh: 这对我们的孩子和孙辈来说就不那么幸运了。

sentences.en: You related to half the town?
sentences.zh: 你和半个镇的人都有亲戚关系？

sentences.en: Um, about a quarter of it.
These levee festivals were always well attended.
sentences.zh: 这些堤坝节总是人头攒动。

sentences.en: Although Leanne admits that a lot of people were probably just coming for the tamales.
sentences.zh: 尽管莉安承认，很多人可能只是为了玉米粽而来的。

sentences.en: It was our biggest moneymaker, but by the end of the levee, when we stopped doing the festivals,
sentences.zh: 这是我们最大的收入来源，但在堤坝项目结束、我们停止举办节日时，

sentences.en: we were up to 60 dozen, and it meant we sold out in two hours.
sentences.zh: 我们已经能卖出60打，这意味着我们在两小时内就售罄了。

sentences.en: If you wanted tamales, you had to get there first, okay?
sentences.zh: 如果你想吃玉米粽，你得先到，明白吗？

sentences.en: Because within two hours, they were sold.
sentences.zh: 因为不到两个小时，它们就卖光了。

sentences.en: Politicians that came in and said, we're just in here for tamales.
sentences.zh: 有些政客过来后说，我们只是为了玉米粽来的。

sentences.en: And it was like, hey, you're late.
sentences.zh: 当时的感觉就是，嘿，你来晚了。

sentences.en: The levee festivals were really successful fundraisers.
sentences.zh: 堤坝节是非常成功的筹款活动。

sentences.en: They made it possible for the town to hire a lawyer who knew his way around federal infrastructure policy.
sentences.zh: 它们使该镇能够聘请一位精通联邦基础设施政策的律师。

sentences.en: But Leanne and Jose were nowhere near the millions of dollars they needed for the local contribution to the coSt.
sentences.zh: 但莉安和何塞距离支付当地配套资金所需的数百万美元还差得很远。

sentences.en: And in the year 2000, help arrived in the unlikely form of an ecologiSt.
sentences.zh: 而在2000年，一位生态学家以一种意想不到的方式带来了帮助。

sentences.en: So how does a community of 2,000 people that's severely economically disadvantaged come up with millions of dollars?
sentences.zh: 那么，一个经济极其困难、只有2000人的社区，该如何筹集数百万美元呢？

sentences.en: They're not going to do that selling tamales.
sentences.zh: 靠卖玉米粽是做不到的。

sentences.en: This is Ryan Luster from The Nature Conservancy.
sentences.zh: 这位是大自然保护协会的瑞安·拉斯特。

sentences.en: And he would end up being a key part of the solution to the two seemingly insurmountable obstacles facing Hamilton City.
sentences.zh: 他最终成为了解决汉密尔顿市面临的两个看似不可逾越的障碍的关键人物。

sentences.en: How to raise millions of dollars and how to get around the all-important benefit-cost ratio.
sentences.zh: 如何筹集数百万美元，以及如何绕过那个至关重要的效益成本比。

sentences.en: Ryan was working along the river doing habitat restoration when the federal government made a key tweak in how they calculated the ratio.
sentences.zh: 瑞安当时正在河边进行栖息地恢复工作，这时联邦政府对效益比的计算方式做出了关键调整。

sentences.en: Basically, they said if you could design a levy that also restored habitat,
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们说如果你能设计出一道既能防洪又能恢复栖息地的堤坝，

sentences.en: they would take that into account when they were calculating whether the project was worth spending money on.
sentences.zh: 他们在计算该项目是否值得投入资金时，会将这一点考虑在内。

sentences.en: They said you can now include ecosystem benefits in your calculations.
sentences.zh: 他们说现在可以将生态系统效益纳入计算范围。

sentences.en: And when the folks in Hamilton City heard about this, they thought that could be the solution to our benefit-cost problem.
sentences.zh: 当汉密尔顿市的人们听到这个消息时，他们认为这可能是解决我们效益成本问题的方案。

sentences.en: So that's why the community came to us and said, hey, will you guys partner with us and help us, you know, with the restoration side of this?
sentences.zh: 所以社区找到我们说，嘿，你们愿意和我们合作，在恢复生态方面帮帮我们吗？

sentences.en: And when you say the community, how much was that Jose and Leanne?
sentences.zh: 当你提到“社区”时，这在多大程度上是指何塞和莉安？

sentences.en: It was pretty much them, yeah.
And so Ryan and Jose and Leanne and a bunch of local farmers started working together.
sentences.zh: 于是瑞安、何塞、莉安和一群当地农民开始合作。

sentences.en: And I really can't stress enough what a surprising collaboration this was.
sentences.zh: 我真的怎么强调这次合作的令人惊讶都不为过。

sentences.en: In this part of California, farmers and conservationists are often on the opposite sides of disputes about how to use land and water.
sentences.zh: 在加州的这个地区，农民和环保主义者在土地和水资源的使用争议上往往处于对立面。

sentences.en: Leanne grew up in an old farming family where environmentalist was a dirty word.
sentences.zh: 莉安成长于一个传统的农耕家庭，在那里“环保主义者”是个贬义词。

sentences.en: I was an adult in my 30s when I came and worked on this project.
sentences.zh: 我30多岁时参与了这个项目。

sentences.en: And all that I could think of is if my grandfather knew what I was doing right now, he'd be so upset.
sentences.zh: 我当时唯一能想到的就是，如果我祖父知道我现在在做什么，他一定会非常生气。

sentences.en: And for his part, Ryan certainly never thought he was ever going to be a part of an effort to build a levy.
sentences.zh: 而瑞安本人也从未想过自己会参与到修建堤坝的努力中。

sentences.en: In fact, Ryan had spent much of his career trying to undo all the damage that levies had caused.
sentences.zh: 事实上，瑞安职业生涯的大部分时间都在试图修复堤坝造成的破坏。

sentences.en: Because you look at a levy, it's like, oh, that's bad for the ecosystem, right?
sentences.zh: 因为当你看到一道堤坝时，你会觉得，噢，这对生态系统有害，对吧？

sentences.en: In order to better understand why levies have traditionally been so bad for the rivers of the Central Valley,
sentences.zh: 为了更好地理解为什么堤坝传统上对中央谷地的河流危害如此之大，

sentences.en: I took a trip to the newest state park in California.
sentences.zh: 我去了加州最新的州立公园。

sentences.en: And it's the site of one of the largest floodplain restoration projects in the state.
sentences.zh: 它是该州最大的洪泛区恢复项目之一的所在地。

sentences.en: Welcome to the next California state park.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到下一个加州州立公园。

sentences.en: My guide for the day is Austin Stephenott, a field manager with the organization River Partners
sentences.zh: 我今天的向导是奥斯汀·斯蒂芬诺特，他是“河流伙伴”组织的现场经理，

sentences.en: and a member of the Northern Sierra Miwok tribe.
sentences.zh: 也是北塞拉米沃克部落的成员。

sentences.en: We're walking through a shady grove of oak trees along the San Joaquin River.
sentences.zh: 我们正走在圣华金河畔一片阴凉的橡树林中。

sentences.en: These trees are probably 100 years old and for whatever reason weren't cleared.
sentences.zh: 这些树大概有一百岁了，不知为何没有被砍伐。

sentences.en: But this is right in front of you is kind of a glimpse of what it might have actually looked like.
sentences.zh: 但你眼前所见，正是这片土地曾经真实样貌的一瞥。

sentences.en: And that's why I brought you here.
sentences.zh: 这就是我带你来这儿的原因。

sentences.en: Austin says that hundreds of years ago, the Central Valley looked completely different than it does today.
sentences.zh: 奥斯汀说，几百年前的中央谷地与今天截然不同。

sentences.en: It was covered with a vast mosaic of riparian forests and wetlands that were tended by different indigenous groups.
sentences.zh: 那时这里覆盖着大片由不同原住民群体照料的河岸森林和湿地。

sentences.en: There were tule elk roaming through the marshlands and grizzly bears feeding on the massive salmon runs.
sentences.zh: 图尔麋鹿在沼泽地漫步，灰熊则以洄游的鲑鱼群为食。

sentences.en: They talk about the salmon run was so immense that at night you could hardly sleep sometimes
sentences.zh: 他们说当年的鲑鱼洄游规模极其壮观，有时晚上你根本睡不着觉，

sentences.en: because there's so many salmon coming up the river you could just hear them.
sentences.zh: 因为有太多的鲑鱼涌入河中，你甚至能听到它们的声音。

sentences.en: This region doesn't get a lot of rain, but the wetlands were irrigated naturally by the rivers that meandered across the valley floor.
sentences.zh: 这个地区降雨量并不多，但湿地由蜿蜒穿过谷底的河流自然灌溉。

sentences.en: During winter storms and the spring snowmelt, the Sacramento and the San Joaquin would fan out across the landscape.
sentences.zh: 在冬季风暴和春季融雪期间，萨克拉门托河和圣华金河会漫溢到整个景观中。

sentences.en: Occasionally, during really big floods, the entire Central Valley was transformed into a vast inland sea.
sentences.zh: 偶尔在特大洪水期间，整个中央谷地会变成一片广阔的内陆海。

sentences.en: It turned the valley into a giant lake, essentially.
sentences.zh: 本质上，它把山谷变成了一个巨大的湖泊。

sentences.en: But in the 19th and 20th century, farmers took over the valley and settled in little towns like Hamilton City.
sentences.zh: 但在19和20世纪，农民们接管了山谷，并在汉密尔顿城这样的小镇定居下来。

sentences.en: And for them, these erratic seasonal floods were deeply inconvenient.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，这些反复无常的季节性洪水非常令人困扰。

sentences.en: The idea became that we need to control the rivers, right?
sentences.zh: 于是人们认为，我们需要控制河流，对吧？

sentences.en: Because you didn't want the river jumping up and flooding out your field that you had just planted in the springtime.
sentences.zh: 因为你肯定不希望河流突然暴涨，淹没你春天刚种下的庄稼。
所以他们开始修建堤坝。

sentences.en: They dammed the rivers and built levees right up against the banks to prevent the floods,
sentences.zh: 他们筑坝拦河，并紧贴河岸修建堤坝以防洪水，

sentences.en: effectively cutting off the wetlands from their water source.
sentences.zh: 实际上切断了湿地的水源。

sentences.en: Today, the valley is mostly dry, dusty farmland.
sentences.zh: 如今，山谷大部分是干燥、尘土飞扬的农田。

sentences.en: The marshes and the forests are almost entirely gone.
sentences.zh: 沼泽和森林几乎完全消失了。

sentences.en: We've lost 95% of this ecosystem up and down the state in the last 100 years.
sentences.zh: 在过去100年里，我们失去了全州95%的这种生态系统。

sentences.en: So it's, it's, a lot of people don't know about it or understand it.
sentences.zh: 所以，很多人对此并不了解，也不理解。

sentences.en: Levees enabled much of the 20th century development in the Central Valley.
sentences.zh: 堤坝促成了20世纪中央谷地的大部分开发。

sentences.en: But that came at an enormous ecological coSt.
sentences.zh: 但这付出了巨大的生态代价。

sentences.en: And it also hasn't guaranteed safety.
sentences.zh: 而且它也没能保证安全。

sentences.en: Because when levees are built right up against the banks of the river, the water has nowhere to go.
sentences.zh: 因为当堤坝紧贴河岸修建时，水流无处可去。

sentences.en: It can't spread out like it once did.
sentences.zh: 它无法像过去那样向外漫延。

sentences.en: And if there's a big storm, like the ones we should expect with climate change,
sentences.zh: 如果发生大风暴，比如我们预料中气候变化带来的那种，

sentences.en: the river just gushes through the channel with increasing ferocity.
sentences.zh: 河流就会以越来越猛烈的势头冲过河道。

sentences.en: And if it gets high enough and angry enough, it can overtop or bust through a levee
sentences.zh: 如果水位够高、水势够猛，它就能漫过或冲垮堤坝，

sentences.en: and flood the towns and fields that were supposed to be protected.
sentences.zh: 淹没那些本应受到保护的城镇和农田。

sentences.en: But our unlikely team of farmers and conservationists had an idea for a different kind of levee at Hamilton City.
sentences.zh: 但我们在汉密尔顿城的一群农民和环保人士组成的“非典型团队”对堤坝有了新想法。

sentences.en: A levee that would be good for both the town and for the river.
sentences.zh: 一种既有利于城镇又有利于河流的堤坝。

sentences.en: We all had a common purpose, okay?
sentences.zh: 我们都有一个共同的目标，明白吗？

sentences.en: For the community and the farmers, the interest was flood protection.
sentences.zh: 对于社区和农民来说，利益在于防洪。

sentences.en: For the environmental community, they had the interest on restoring land back to its natural habitat.
sentences.zh: 对于环保界来说，他们关心的是将土地恢复到自然栖息地。

sentences.en: The idea was that instead of building a new levee right along the bank of the river,
sentences.zh: 想法是，与其在河岸边修建新堤坝，

sentences.en: they would set it back a mile or so inland, closer to the edge of town.
sentences.zh: 不如将其向内陆后撤一英里左右，靠近城镇边缘。

sentences.en: And then, and here's the part that Ryan was particularly into,
sentences.zh: 然后——这就是瑞安特别感兴趣的部分——

sentences.en: they would tear down the old one.
We need to remove the levee that's along the river so that the river now has room to spread out.
sentences.zh: 我们需要拆除河边的堤坝，让河流有空间漫延开来。

sentences.en: The technique of making room for the river comes from the Dutch.
sentences.zh: 这种“给河流留空间”的技术源自荷兰人。

sentences.en: And the logic is pretty simple.
Instead of trying to tightly control the river in this narrow channel,
sentences.zh: 与其试图将河流紧紧限制在狭窄的河道中，

sentences.en: you want to give it more room to spread out across the floodplain.
sentences.zh: 不如给它更多空间，让它在洪泛区漫延。

sentences.en: This is not only good for the ecology of the river, but it's safer for people.
sentences.zh: 这不仅对河流生态有益，对人类也更安全。

sentences.en: Because it slows the water down and makes it less dangerous.
sentences.zh: 因为它减缓了水流，降低了危险性。

sentences.en: And when the river floods, it's not really a problem.
sentences.zh: 当河流泛滥时，这其实不是问题。

sentences.en: Because the water just flows onto a floodplain that was designed to get wet.
sentences.zh: 因为水流只会流向本就设计用来蓄水的洪泛区。

sentences.en: So instead of fighting nature, let's use nature to our own advantage.
